title: Management direction for information security
description: Does management  provide direction and support for information security in accordance with business requirements and relevant laws and regulations?

title: Policies for information security
description: Is there an information security policy document, or set of policies, that has been defined, approved by management, and has it been published and communicated to all employees and relevant external parties?

title: Review of the policies for information security
description: Is there a procedure for the information security policy, or policies, to be reviewed at planned intervals or if significant changes occur, and does this process ensure its continuing suitability, adequacy, and effectiveness, and is there evidence that the policy (or policies) is applied?

title: Internal organisation
description: Is there a management framework to initiate and control the implementation and operation of information security within the organisation?

title: Information security roles and responsibilities
description: Have all information security responsibilities been defined and allocated?

title: Segregation of duties
description: Have conflicting duties and areas of responsibility been segregated to reduce opportunities for unauthorised or unintentional modification or misuse of the organisation's assets?

title: Contact with authorities
description: Does the organisation maintain appropriate contacts with relevant authorities?

title: Contact with special interest groups
description: Does the organisation maintain appropriate contact with special interest groups or other specialist security forums and professional associations?

title: Information security in project management
description: Does the organisation address information security in project management, regardless of the type of project?

title: Mobile devices and teleworking
description: Does the organisation ensure the security of teleworking and use of mobile devices?

title: Mobile device policy
description: Does the organisation have a policy and supporting security measures to manage the risks introduced by the use of mobile devices?

title: Teleworking
description: Does the organisation have a policy and supporting security measures to protect information accessed, processed or stored at teleworking sites?

title: Prior to employment
description: Does the organisation ensure that employees and contractors understand their responsibilities and are suitable for the roles for which they are considered?

title: Screening
description: Does the organisation conduct background verification checks on all candidates for employment, in accordance with relevant laws, regulations and ethics, and are these checks proportional to the business requirements, the classification of the information to be accessed and the perceived risks?

title: Terms and conditions of employment
description: Do contractual agreements with employees and contractors state their and the organisation's responsibilities for information security?

title: During employment
description: Does the organisation ensure that employees and contractors are aware of and fulfil their information security responsibilities?

title: Management responsibilities
description: Does the organisation's management require all employees and contractors to apply information security in accordance with the organisation's established policies and procedures?

title: Information security awareness, education and training
Disciplinary process
description: Does the organisation have a formal and communicated disciplinary process in place to take action against employees who commit an information security breach?

title: Termination and change of employment
description: Does the organisation protect its interests as part of the process of changing or terminating employment?

title: Termination or change of employment responsibilities
description: Does the organisation define and enforce information security responsibilities and duties that remain valid after termination or change of employment, and are these communicated to the employee or contractor?

title: Responsibility for assets
description: Has the organisation identified organisational assets and defined appropriate protection responsibilities?

title: Inventory of assets
description: Has the organisation identified assets associated with information and information processing facilities, and has an inventory of these assets been drawn up and maintained?

title: Ownership of assets
description: Have owners of the assets maintained in the asset inventory been identified?

title: Acceptable use of assets
description: Has the organisation identified, documented and implemented rules for the acceptable use of information and of assets associated with information and information processing facilities?

title: Return of assets
description: Does the organisation requite all employees and external party users to return all of the organisational assets in their possession upon termination of their employment, contract or agreement?

title: Information classification
description: Does the organisation ensure that information receives an appropriate level of protection in accordance with its importance to the organisation?

title: Classification of information
description: Does the organisation classify information in terms of legal requirements, value, criticality and sensitivity to unauthorised disclosure or modification?

title: Labelling of information
description: Has the organisation developed and implemented an appropriate set of procedures for information labelling in accordance with the information classification scheme?

title: Handling of assets
description: Has the organisation developed and implemented procedures for handling assets in accordance with the information classification scheme?

title: Media handling
description: Does the organisation prevent unauthorised disclosure, modification, removal or destruction of information stored on media?

title: Management of removable media
description: Has the organisation implemented procedures for the management of removable media in accordance with the classification scheme?

title: Disposal of media
description: Does the organisation have formal procedures for the disposal of media securely when no longer required?

title: Physical media transfer
description: Does the organisation protect media containing information against unauthorised access, misuse or corruption during transportation?

title: Business requirements of access control
description: Does the organisation limit access to information and information processing facilities?

title: Access control policy
description: Has the organisation established, documented and reviewed an access control policy based on business and information security requirements?

title: Access to networks and network services
description: Are users restricted to access only those networks and network services that they have been specifically authorised to use?

title: User access management
description: Does the organisation have processes in place to ensure authorised user access and to prevent unauthorised access to systems and services?

title: User registration and de-registration
description: Is there a formal user registration and de-registration process to enable assignment of access rights?

title: User access provisioning
description: Is there a formal user access provisioning process to assign or revoke access rights for all user types to all systems and services?

title: Management of privileged access rights
description: Does the organisation restrict and control the allocation and use of privileged access rights?

title: Management of secret authentication information of users
description: Does the organisation have a formal management process to control the allocation of secret authentication information?

title: Review of user access rights
description: Do asset owners review users' access rights at regular intervals?

title: Removal or adjustment of access rights
description: Does the organisation removal (or adjust) access rights of employees and external party users to information and information processing facilities upon termination (or change) of their employment, contract or agreement?

title: User responsibilities
description: Are users accountable for safeguarding their authentication information?

title: Use of secret authentication information
description: Are users required to follow the organisation's established practices in the use of secret authentication information?

title: System and application access control
description: Does the organisation prevent unauthorised access to systems and applications?

title: Information access restriction
description: Does the organisation restrict access to information and application system functions in accordance with the access control policy?

title: Secure log-on procedures
description: Is there a secure log-on procedure to control access to systems and applications where required by the access control policy?

title: Password management system
description: Are the password management systems interactive and do they ensure quality passwords?

title: Use of privileged utility programs
description: Is the use of utility programs that might be capable of overriding system and application controls restricted and tightly controlled?

title: Access control to program source code
description: Is access to program source code restricted?

title: Cryptographic controls
description: Is cryptography properly and effectively used to protect the confidentiality, authenticity and/or integrity of information?

title: Policy on the use of cryptographic controls
description: Has the organisation developed and implemented a policy on its use of cryptographic controls for protection of its information?

title: Key management
description: Has the organisation developed and implemented a policy on the use, protection and lifetime of cryptographic keys?

title: Secure areas
description: Does the organisation prevent unauthorised physical access, damage and interference to the organisation's information and information processing facilities?

title: Physical security perimeter
description: Has the organisation defined security perimeters, and does it use them to protect areas that contain either sensitive or critical information and information processing facilities?

title: Physical entry controls
description: Are secure areas protected by appropriate entry controls to ensure that only authorised personnel are allowed access?

title: Securing offices, rooms and facilities
description: Has the organisation designed and applied physical security for offices, rooms and facilities?

title: Protecting against external and environmental threats
description: Has the organisation designed and applied physical protection against natural disasters, malicious attacks and accidents?

title: Working in secure areas
description: Have procedures for working in secure areas been designed and applied?

title: Delivery and loading areas
description: Does the organisation control or isolate access points such as delivery and loading areas, and other points where unauthorised persons could enter the premises?

title: Equipment
description: Does the organisation prevent loss, damage, theft and compromise of assets and interruption to the organisation's operations?

title: Equipment siting and protection
description: Is equipment sited and protected to reduce the risks from environmental threats and hazards, and opportunities for unauthorised access?

title: Supporting utilities
description: Is equipment protected from power failures and other disruptions caused by failures in supporting utilities?

title: Cabling security
description: Is power and telecommunication cabling carrying data or supporting information services protected from interception, interference and damage?

title: Equipment maintenance
description: Is equipment correctly maintained to ensure continued availability and integrity?

title: Removal of assets
description: Does the organisation prevent equipment, information and software from being taken off-site without prior authorisation?

title: Security of equipment and assets off-premises
description: Is security applied to off-site assets, and does this take into account the different risks of working outside the organisation's premises?

title: Secure disposal or re-use of equipment
description: Does the organisation have a procedure or procedures to verify that equipment containing storage media has had any sensitive data and licensed software removed or securely overwritten prior to disposal or re-use?

title: Unattended user equipment
description: Do users ensure that unattended equipment has appropriate protection?

title: Clear desk and clear screen policy
description: Is there a clear desk policy for papers and removable storage media, and a clear screen policy for information processing facilities?

title: Operational procedures and responsibilities
description: Does the organisation ensure correct and secure operations of information processing facilities?

title: Documented operating procedures
description: Are operating procedures documented and made available to all users who need them?

title: Change management
description: Does the organisation control changes to the organisation, business processes, information processing facilities and systems that affect information security?

title: Capacity management
description: Is the use of resources monitored and tuned, and are projections made of future capacity requirements, to ensure the required system performance?

title: Separation of development, testing and operational environments
description: Are the development, testing and operational environments separated to reduce the risks of unauthorised access and changes to the operational environment?

title: Protection from malware
description: Are information and information processing facilities protected against malware?

title: Controls against malware
description: Has the organisation implemented detection, prevention and recovery controls to protect against malware, and this is combined with appropriate user awareness?

title: Backup
description: Does the organisation protect against loss of data?

title: Information backup
description: Is there an agreed backup policy, and are backup copies of information, software and system images taken and tested regularly in accordance with this policy?

title: Logging and monitoring
description: Does the organisation record events and generate evidence?

title: Event logging
description: Does the organisation produce, keep and regularly review event logs recording user activities, exceptions, faults and information security events?

title: Protection of log information
description: Are logging facilities and log information protected against tampering and unauthorised access?

title: Administrator and operator logs
description: Are system administrator and system operator activities logged, and are the logs protected and regularly reviewed?

title: Clock synchronisation
description: Are the clocks of all relevant information processing systems within an organisation or security domain synchronised with a single reference time source?

title: Control of operational software
description: Is the integrity of operational systems ensured?

title: Installation of software on operational systems
description: Are procedures implemented to control the installation of software on operational systems?

title: Technical vulnerability management
description: Does the organisation prevent the exploitation of technical vulnerabilities?

title: Management of technical vulnerabilities
description: Is timely information about technical vulnerabilities of information systems being used obtained, is the organisation’s exposure to such vulnerabilities evaluated, and are the appropriate measures taken to address the associated risk?

title: Restrictions on software installation
description: Has the organisation established and implemented rules governing the installation of software by users?

title: Information systems audit considerations
description: Does the organisation minimise the impact of audit activities on operational systems?

title: Information systems audit controls
description: Are audit requirements and activities involving verification of operational systems carefully planned and agreed to minimise disruptions to business processes?

title: Network security management
description: Does the organisation protect information in networks and supporting information processing facilities?

title: Network controls
description: Are networks managed and controls to protect information in systems and applications?

title: Security of network services
description: Are security mechanisms, service levels and management requirements of all network services identified and included in network services agreements, whether provided in-house or outsourced?

title: Segregation in networks
description: Are groups of information services, users and information systems segregated on networks?

title: Information transfer
description: Is the security of information transferred within the organisation and with any external entity maintained?

title: Information transfer policies and procedures
description: Are formal transfer policies, procedures and controls in place to protect the transfer of information through the use of all types of communication facilities?

title: Agreements on information transfer
description: Do agreements address the secure transfer of business information between the organisation and external parties?

title: Electronic messaging
description: Is information involved in electronic messaging appropriately protected?

title: Confidentiality or non-disclosure agreements
description: Are requirements for confidentiality or non-disclosure agreements reflecting the organisations needs for the protection of information identified, regularly reviewed and documented?

title: Security requirements of information systems
description: Does the organisation ensure that security is an integral party of information systems, including those information systems that provide services over public networks?

title: Information security requirements analysis and specification
description: Are information security related requirements included in the requirements for new information systems and enhancements to existing information systems?

title: Securing application services on public networks
description: Is information involved in application services passing over public networks protected from fraudulent activity, contract dispute and unauthorised disclosure and modification?

title: Protecting application services transactions
description: Is information involved in application service transactions protected to prevent incomplete transmission, mis-routing, unauthorised message alteration, unauthorised disclosure, unauthorised message duplication and replay?

title: Security in development and support processes
description: Is information security designed and implemented within the development lifecycle of information systems?

title: Secure development policy
description: Are there established rules for the development of software and systems, and are they applied to developments within the organisation?

title: System change control procedures
description: Are there formal change control procedures to control changes to systems within the development lifecycle?

title: Technical review of applications after operating platform changes
description: When operating systems are changed, are business critical applications reviewed and tested to ensure there is no adverse impact on organisational operations or security?

title: Restrictions on changes to software packages
description: Are modifications to software packages discouraged, limited to necessary changes and are all changes strictly controlled?

title: Secure system engineering principles
description: Have principles for engineering secure systems been established, documented and maintained, and have they been applied to information system implementation efforts?

title: Secure development environment
description: Has the organisation established and appropriately protected secure development environments for system development and integration efforts, covering the entire system development lifecycle?

title: Outsourced development
description: Does the organisation supervise and monitor the activity of outsourced system development?

title: System security testing
description: Is testing of security functionality conducted during development?

title: System acceptance criteria
description: Are there acceptance testing programs and have related criteria been established for new information systems, upgrades and new versions?

title: Test data
description: Is data used for testing protected?

title: Protection of test data
description: Is test data selected carefully, and is it protected and controlled?

title: Information security in supplier relationships
description: Are the organisation's assets that are accessible by suppliers protected?

title: Information security policy for supplier relationships
description: Are information security requirements for mitigating the risks associated with supplier's access to the organisation's assets agreed with the supplier and documented?

title: Addressing security within supplier agreements
description: Are all relevant information security requirements established and agreed with each supplier that may access, process, store, communicate, or provide IT infrastructure for, the organisation's information?

title: Information and communication technology supply chain
description: Do agreements with suppliers include requirements to address the information security risks associated with information and communications technology services and product supply chain?

title: Supplier service delivery management
description: Does the organisation maintain an agreed level of information security and service delivery in line with supplier agreements?

title: Monitoring and review of supplier services
description: Does the organisation regularly monitor, review and audit supplier service delivery?

title: Managing changes to supplier services
description: Does the organisation manage changes to the provision of services by suppliers, including maintaining and improving existing information security policies, procedures and controls, taking account of the criticality of business information, systems and processes involved, and re-assessment of risks?

title: Management of information security incidents and improvements
description: Does the organisation ensure that a consistent and effective approach is applied to the management of information security incidents, including communication on security events and weaknesses?

title: Responsibilities and procedures
description: Has the organisation established management responsibilities and procedures to ensure a quick, effective and orderly response to information security incidents?

title: Reporting information security events
description: Are information security events reported through appropriate management channels as quickly as possible?

title: Reporting information security weaknesses
description: Does the organisation require employees and contractors using the organisation's information systems and services to note and report any observed or suspected information security weaknesses in systems or services?

title: Assessment of and decision on information security events
description: Does the organisation assess information security events and make decisions as to whether they are classified as information security incidents?

title: Response to information security incidents
description: Are information security incidents responded to in accordance with the documented procedures?

title: Learning from information security incidents
description: Does the organisation use knowledge gained from analysing and resolving information security incidents to reduce the likelihood or impact of future incidents?

title: Collection of evidence
description: Has the organisation defined and applied procedures for the identification, collection, acquisition and preservation of information that can serve as evidence?

title: Information security continuity
description: Is information security continuity embedded in the organisation business continuity management systems?

title: Planning information security continuity
description: Has the organisation determined its requirements for information security and the continuity of information security management in adverse situations (e.g. during a crisis or disaster)?

title: Implementing information security continuity
description: Has the organisation established, documented implemented and maintained processes, procedures and controls that ensure the required level of continuity for information security during an adverse situation?

title: Verify, review and evaluate information security continuity
description: Does the organisation verify the established and implemented information security continuity controls at regular intervals, ensuring that they are valid and effective during adverse situations?

title: Redundancies
description: Is the availability of information processing facilities ensured?

title: Availability of information processing facilities
description: Are information processing facilities implemented with redundancy sufficient to meet availability requirements?

title: Compliance with legal and contractual requirements
description: Does the organisation avoid breaches of legal, statutory, regulatory and contractual obligations related to information security and of any security requirements?

title: Identification of applicable legislation and contractual requirements
description: Have all relevant legislative, statutory, regulatory and contractual requirements and the organization’s approach to meet these requirements been explicitly identified and documented, and is it kept up to date for each information system and the organization?

title: Intellectual property rights (IPR)
description: Have appropriate procedures been implemented to ensure compliance with legislative, regulatory and contractual requirements related to intellectual property rights and use of proprietary software products?

title: Protection of records
description: Are records protected from loss, destruction, falsification, unauthorised access and unauthorised release, in accordance with legislatory, regulatory, contractual and business requirements?

title: Privacy and protection of personally identifiable information
description: Does the organisation ensure privacy and protection of personally identifiable information as required in relevant legislation and regulations?

title: Regulation of cryptographic controls
description: Are cryptographic controls used in compliance with all relevant agreements, legislation and regulations?

title: Information security reviews
description: Does the organisation ensure that information security is implemented and operated in accordance with the organisational policies and procedures?

title: Independent review of information security
description: Is the organisation's approach to managing information security and its implementation reviewed independently and at planned intervals or when significant changes occur?

title: Compliance with security policies and standards
description: Do managers regularly review the compliance of information processing and procedures within their area of responsibility with the appropriate security policies, standards and other security requirements?

title: Technical compliance review
description: Are information systems regularly checked for compliance with the organisation's information security policies and standards?
